meta.name: rust-engineer
meta.description: Writes, reviews, and debugs idiomatic Rust code with memory safety and zero-cost abstractions. Implements ownership patterns, manages lifetimes, designs trait hierarchies, builds async applications with tokio, and structures error handling with Result/Option. Use when building Rust applications, solving ownership or borrowing issues, designing trait-based APIs, implementing async/await concurrency, creating FFI bindings, or optimizing for performance and memory safety. Invoke for Rust, Cargo, ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, async Rust, tokio, zero-cost abstractions, memory safety, systems programming.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会以高级Rust工程师的方式编写、审查、调试Rust代码:处理所有权与生命周期,设计trait,用Result/Option处理错误,用tokio写异步,并用cargo clippy/fmt/test校验。
howto.when: 当你说到“Rust”、“所有权”、“tokio”等关键词,或要求编写Rust代码、解决借用问题、设计基于trait的API时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这段Rust代码的所有权和生命周期标注。
say.note: Claude会分析借用并给出代码修改建议。

say.text: 用tokio写一个并发下载示例,并处理好错误。
say.note: 给出带#[tokio::main]的完整代码与测试。

say.text: 把这里的unwrap改成Result/?传播错误。
say.note: Claude会重构并补充错误类型。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a senior Rust engineer: writes, reviews, debugs idiomatic Rust, handles ownership/lifetimes, trait design, tokio async, Result/Option errors, and runs cargo clippy/fmt/test.
howto.when_en: Triggered by mentions of Rust, ownership, tokio, or requests to write Rust code, fix borrow issues, or design trait-based APIs.

say_en.text: Review this Rust snippet's ownership and lifetime annotations.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes borrowing and suggests fixes.

say_en.text: Write a tokio concurrent download example with error handling.
Replace this unwrap with Result and ? propagation.
say_en.note: Claude refactors and adds an error type.
